headline: Robustness and Benchmarking of Cell-Type-Resolved Inference Methods From Transcriptomic…
label: Cell Type Resolved Method Benchmarking
summary: Recent preprints and papers assess the robustness and reproducibility of cell-type-resolved methods across datasets and cohorts, not only single-method…
synthesis: The common thread is computational frameworks that extract cell-type-resolved information from transcriptomic data and evaluate those outputs against explicit benchmarks. Several items focus on evaluation itself: scRepresenter benchmarks cellular embeddings from foundation models and knowledge-guided methods, and FERRET scores single-cell gene regulatory network inference by within- versus between-cell-type robustness. Others address deconvolution, including RETROFIT for reference-free spatial transcriptomics and cellGeometry for bulk RNA-seq, and a BayesPrism-derived set of 83 cell-type expression targets for sequence-to-expression models. SLMC contributes donor-robust minimal gene sets that reconstruct disease-aligned profiles with 25 genes. The newer element visible here is emphasis on modular, reproducible packaging and head-to-head evaluation. The set remains heterogeneous, spanning immuno-oncology, biobank association pipelines, and cfDNA fragmentomics.
